description: Read-only discovery search across current public or authorized web information when the request is not already covered by a known PaidHandshake inventory product. Returns one evidence-bearing proof result, locked ranked previews, pricing, and a reusable search_id. Use get_live_inventory/get_free_data_sample for known inventory products instead, and use quote_paid_machine_job for delegated custom research work.

query.description: Natural-language discovery request, 3-600 characters. Include meaningful constraints such as location, timing, budget, product/service type, opportunity type, or other criteria needed to rank relevant current results.
